test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Pipes A and B can fill a tank for 8 hours and 10 hours, respectively, and pipe C can empty the full tank in 12 hours. All three pipes are opened together, but pipe A is closed after 4 hours. In how many hours will the remaining part of tank be filled?
solution:
Given:

Pipe A can fill the tank in 8 hours 

Pipe B can fill the tank in 10 hours 

Pipe C can empty the tank in 12 hours 

All three pipes are opened together, but Pipe A is closed after 4 hours.

Formula Used:

Work done = Rate × Time

Calculation:

Let total capacity of tank = 120 liters (LCM of 8, 10, and 12)

Efficiency of A = 15 L/h

Efficiency of B = 12 L/h

Efficiency of C = 10 L/h

Work done per hour by all three pipes:

15 + 12 - 10 = 17 liters per hour

Work Done in First 4 Hours

Work done in 4 hours: 17 × 4 = 68 liters

Remaining capacity of the tank:

120 - 68 = 52 liters

Work Done After Closing Pipe A

Now only pipes B and C are open: Work done per hour by B and C:

12 - 10 = 2 liters per hour

Time Required to Fill Remaining Tank = 52 / 2 = 26 hours

The remaining part of the tank will be filled in 26 hours.
